$comment: Applied output of the brand-strategist agent. Extracted from clients/aditis/kitchen/site/content/brand.ts — single source of truth for the marketing site. This is the default-target-audience client (South Asian SMB, Loudoun), so desi-diaspora-voice applies fully and whatsapp_broadcast is enabled.
tagline: Real South Indian. Fresh dosas. Open Tuesday through Sunday.
short_intro: A family-run kitchen in Ashburn — dosas on a hot tava, idli steamed in the morning, filter coffee poured strong. Recipes from Aditi's amma, kept the same way for twenty years.

signature_dishes.name: Mysore Masala Dosa
signature_dishes.why_signature: 16-hour fermented batter, fresh-ground red masala, ghee-roasted on a hot tava — the dish people drive in from Sterling for

signature_dishes.name: Ghee Roast
signature_dishes.why_signature: crisp golden edges, served with three chutneys and sambar — the simplest test of whether a kitchen knows what it's doing

signature_dishes.name: Parippuvada
signature_dishes.why_signature: Kerala lentil fritters, fried every two hours in small batches — the snack that runs out by 7pm on most evenings

visual_palette.notes: Kerala green primary (the brand anchor — banana leaf, palm, monsoon backdrop), saffron accent for festival pushes only, warm offwhite ground, dark green-black ink.

locations.label: Ashburn
locations.address_todo: operator: confirm street address with owner
locations.phone_todo: operator: replace placeholder with real phone

do_use: amma's recipe, kept the same way for twenty years
filter coffee, pulled strong, in a steel tumbler
parippuvada fries every two hours — runs out by 7pm
Kerala-style avial, coconut from the bag, not from a can

channels_in_scope.whatsapp_note: Aditi's audience IS WhatsApp-native (South Asian Loudoun community). Default ON. Operator forwards the broadcast message; client copy-pastes to their broadcast list.
channels_in_scope.ads: out of scope (CLAUDE.md §1: no paid ads, organic only)

competitive_lens: Aditi's edge over the half-dozen North-Indian-leaning restaurants in Ashburn is the Kerala-specific anchor — parippuvada, avial, ghee roast, filter coffee in a tumbler. Don't generic-ify it. The Malayalee + Tamil diaspora in Loudoun will drive 40 minutes for this; the broader desi audience finds it via dosa.
